name: Nogizaka Haruka no Himitsu: Cosplay, Hajimemashita♥
original_name: 乃木坂春香の秘密 こすぷれ、はじめました♥
source:
"You know, cosplay is really good!" When Haruka, Yuuto, and Shina are at a cafe, they meet Rio, Shina's old friend and Rio invites them to take part in a cosplay event. "Well, I'll take part in it." "It should be fun!" "How about you, Haruka?" Haruka seems to hesitate to answer. At that moment, Yuuto notices that she stares at a pamphlet of the event...

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20080928065257/http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/11097]Himeya Shop[/url]]
translation:
“跟你们说哦，Cosplay真的超棒的！”春香、裕人与椎菜在咖啡厅小聚时，偶遇了椎菜的旧识利绪，对方热情邀请三人参加一场Cosplay活动。“好呀，我参加！”“听起来一定很有意思！”“春香，你觉得呢？”面对询问，春香却显得欲言又止。就在这时，裕人留意到她的目光正紧紧停留在那份活动宣传册上……

[译自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20080928065257/http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/11097]Himeya Shop[/url]]
